packageRules.description: Track ISC's kea-dhcp4/kea-dhcp6 (cloudsmith) and bump each Dockerfile's ARG VERSION. Both components track the same Kea release, so Renovate groups them into one PR by default. Restrict to STABLE releases only: ISC ships stable on even minor series (3.0, 3.2, 3.4, ...) and development snapshots on odd minors (3.1, 3.3), which must never reach the fleet. The even-minor regex excludes odd-minor dev tags.
